sentences.en: I feel as if I were aboard a great ship.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己仿佛置身于一艘大船上。

sentences.en: The child came aboard the plane in a good mood.
sentences.zh: 孩子心情愉快地登上了飞机。

sentences.en: All the passengers aboard were killed in the crash.
sentences.zh: 所有在事故中的乘客都遇难了。

senses.zh: 在船(车)上；在火车上；在飞机上
